findings.finding: Graph already tracks Claude Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Mythos 5, Haiku 4.5, Opus 4.8, and earlier Opus/Sonnet versions. Claude Opus 5 has an existing open model-version issue.
Graph tracks GPT-5.5/GPT-5 family, GPT-4o, and gpt-oss. GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna already has an open model-version issue.
Graph tracks Gemini 3.1 Pro/Deep Think/Flash Lite/Flash Live/TTS and Gemini 3.x records. Gemini 3.6 Flash and related Flash-Lite/Cyber coverage already has open model-version issues.
Graph tracks Grok 4.5. Grok 4.20 variants have an existing model-version issue marked duplicate.
Graph tracks Llama 4 Scout and Llama 4 Maverick with provider availability through Meta/direct and inference providers. No untracked Llama 4.x release was confirmed in this run.
Graph tracks DeepSeek R1, V3, V4 Pro, and V4 Flash. DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 has an open model-version issue.
Graph tracks Mistral Large 3, Medium/Codestral/Pixtral family records, and provider edges. Mistral Small 4 and Large 3 issue searches returned existing issues.
Graph tracks Qwen 3.7 Max/Plus and earlier Qwen/Qwen-Coder models. Qwen3.8-Max and qwen3.8-max-preview already have an open model-version issue.
Graph tracks Amazon Nova 2 Lite, Sonic, Omni, and Nova 2 Pro Preview with Bedrock provider/model-transport sidecars and evidence.
Graph tracks Command A+, Command A Reasoning/Vision, Embed v4-era coverage, and Cohere provider transports. Cohere Transcribe 03-2026 has an existing duplicate issue.
Together AI serverless catalog refresh already has an open issue. A specific missing model gap was found for Thinking Machines Inkling / Inkling Small on Together AI; created issue #1656.

Graph tracks Fireworks AI as an OpenAI-compatible inference provider with 2026-05 catalog evidence and model/provider edges for major open models. No distinct Fireworks-only untracked model was confirmed beyond existing closed/open catalog issues.
Groq has an open 2026-08 inference model catalog refresh issue; graph tracks Groq provider and existing model edges.
